notes: Eval 3 (Invoke-Build) shows the starkest gap: 5/5 with skill vs 0/5 without — without the skill Claude writes functionally correct code but completely bypasses PowerShellBuild conventions
Eval 2 (GitHub Actions CI) shows the smallest gap (5/5 vs 4/5) — GitHub Actions YAML is well-known; the one miss is calling Invoke-Build directly instead of ./build.ps1
The skill actually reduces execution time by ~20s on average — likely because it front-loads the right approach instead of Claude exploring alternatives
Zero variance in with_skill pass rates (all 1.0) vs high variance without skill (0.0-0.8, stddev 0.40) — skill makes behavior highly consistent
The without_skill scaffold invented a non-existent PSBPreference.Lint.Enabled key — the skill prevents hallucinated API usage
